description: Detects and masks personal data (GDPR, including Art. 9 special categories) and confidential information (trade secrets, procurement tenders, FOIA exemptions, and statutory secrecy such as Swedish OSL) in a PDF, DOCX, PPTX, or image document. Takes the document as upload_id (from create_upload_link), file_url, or document_base64 (up to 45 KB), and a policy that selects which detection categories are used. Returns download_url for a flattened PDF with irreversible masks, or review_url when require_human_review is true. Free tier: watermarked PDF, 100 documents per day.

file_url.description: Direct HTTPS URL of the source document to mask.

policy.description: Redaction policy: 'Privacy' (GDPR personal data, default), 'Secrecy' (trade secrets and statutory secrecy/OSL), or 'Privacy and Secrecy' (both).

require_human_review.description: When true, prepares an interactive web GUI review session (review_url) before generating the final PDF. When false (default), generates the masked PDF directly.

upload_id.description: Temporary upload ID representing a file uploaded to the EU server.

name: propose_masking
